summary: ```markdown # Half Skirt Production Tutorial: Umbrella Skirt ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will walk through the process of creating an umbrella skirt using Marvelous Designer. This guide covers essential steps, tools, and techniques for producing a well-structured umbrella skirt. ## Step 1: Prepare the Umbrella To make an umbrella, start by opening the previous umbrella design. Next, delete any excess panels that are not needed for your current project. ## Step 2: Measure the Waist Panel Utilize the edit panel tool to measure the total length of the entire waist panel. In the attribute editor on the right side, you will find the length of the symmetrical correction, which is the total length of two lines. ## Step 3: Create Circle Panels Use the create circle tool to establish a circle panel. The circle length should match the total length you just measured. - **Tip**: Double-click on a line to select the entire line, then right-click to choose the panel outline expansion. - The length of the expansion here represents the length of the skirt at the end. ## Step 4: Adjust Inner Lines Make sure to select the depth line after the expansion; otherwise, the middle line will be absent, and you won't be able to dig the inner line. After selecting the depth line, double-click on the inner line to select it entirely. Switch to the move tool for the next steps. ## Step 5: Preparing for Sewing The hollow section in the middle will be sewn onto the waist. To facilitate this, select the free sewing tool. - **Sewing Technique**: While holding the Shift key, start sewing from the front. Since the process is from left to right, ensure to click from left to right when transitioning to the other side. ## Step 6: Arrange Panels in 3D Space Carefully arrange the panels in 3D space, ensuring that the sewing lines do not cross. After you have opened the model, you will see that the entire umbrella is worn on the model. - **Observation**: The waist should be flat without wrinkles, while the wrinkles will form below due to the large size of the skirt. ## Step 7: Adjusting Thickness and Smoothness The umbrella skirt resembles the front and back skirt we created earlier, but it is a complete circle. To enhance the design, reduce the thickness of the particle joint and the bulge to make it smoother. ### Physical Properties Due to the unique structure of the umbrella skirt, its texture direction changes in all directions. To adjust its physical properties, ensure that its value is consistent with the gold and silver tail. ### Applying Pressure to Fabric To apply pressure to the fabric, click the left arrow and enter a value of 0.5. It is crucial not to add too much pressure; a value of 0.5 or smaller will allow the umbrella skirt to appear slightly bumpy due to its weight and balance of pressure. - **Adjustment**: This setting helps stabilize the skirt, making it more natural. ## Step 8: Modify Bending Intensity If you wish to alter the physical properties further, such as modifying the bending intensity to achieve a stiffer appearance, adjust the gold tail and the bending intensity of the oblique accordingly. ## Step 9: Adding Pleats To add pleats to the umbrella skirt, start by enlarging the entire version. If you feel the skirt has changed too much, you can use the narrowing function to shorten it back to your desired length. ## Conclusion After completing these steps, make sure to save your file to preserve your work. This guide provides a foundational approach to creating an umbrella skirt in Marvelous Designer, focusing on precision and attention to detail. ```
